business_problem: EXL tracked opportunities in CRM, projects in ERP, and resource requests in email and spreadsheets, leaving only a 50% success rate in matching the right talent to the right work.
solution_summary: EXL tracked opportunities in CRM, projects in ERP, and resource requests in email and spreadsheets, leaving only a 50% success rate in matching the right talent to the right work. EXL implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, Strategic Portfolio Management, CRM, and ERP. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; Strategic Portfolio Management connects demand, capacity, and priorities; CRM contributes account and opportunity context; ERP contributes finance and resource data. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, and uses context from CRM and ERP before ServiceNow AI Platform and Strategic Portfolio Management routes or fulfills the work. Updates then flow back to agents, account teams, or customers through the same connected experience. Running post-sales and revenue operations on one data model reduced manual handoffs and made expansion easier.
